request.description: A leaning ancient weeping willow tree creature, narrow curved old trunk and long drooping branch arms forming a forward hunch, curtain of sparse large hanging olive leaf clusters over shoulders, tiny sleepy eyes and furrowed old face inside trunk. Three splayed root feet, asymmetric silhouette with strongly bent upper body, not a straight humanoid. Ancient melancholy woodland giant, left-facing three-quarter battle pose. Keep leaf areas broad and quiet. Dungeon Matcher native 96x96 pixel-art concept sprite, full body at the same source pixel density as the approved cast, approximately 70-82 pixels of occupied height, transparent background with no ground shadow or text. Warm matte bark #4A2C1C #7A4D2E #B07A43, restrained pale deadwood #9F907A #E0D2B8, olive moss #393728 #665F3D #908E58, outline #0A0D11. Aim for 14-18 opaque colors; broad connected base/shadow/light clusters, one-pixel contour, top-left lighting. No gradients, dithering, shiny metal, glowing magic, many small leaf marks, weapons or root-spell effects. Slow ancient miniboss identity, readable charming face.
